materialChanges: Changed the clinical wrap-up to claims-mapped, linked its five applied mathematical claims and six glossary terms, and added a same-scene source note plus an attempt-before-feedback self-explanation check.

Removed the currently agent-restricted OpenStax record from the active source registry and every retained claim and source note; remapped ratio, proportion, percentage, percent-change, and boundary support to the already-cited NIST and Ministry of Justice sources with the proportion relation recorded as an algebraic inference.
Returned all six retained claims to pending-review so the maintainer, rather than this finalizer, performs the separately authorized post-adjudication publication transition.

Corrected attribution to distinguish the cleared version 0.1.0 adjudication from this version 0.2.0 finalization and disclosed the current finalizer run and material-instructions digest without changing lesson identity, version, status, objectives, scene order, duration, or assessment arithmetic.

reviewDispositions.rationale: Set scene-clinical-wrap-up to claims-mapped; added that scene to the five applicable claims and six glossary entries; and added a same-scene source note resolving every retained claim to its complete source set.

Removed OpenStax from references.json and all active evidence bridges. NIST Chapter 8 now supports quotient and per-hundred relations, equal-ratio equations and substitution are recorded as direct algebraic inference from those relations, the Ministry of Justice source supports the starting-reference and percentage-point distinctions, and NIST's measurement-scale source supports the meaningful-zero boundary.

Changed every retained claim reviewStatus from reviewed to pending-review and left lesson status draft and sourceConfidence pending-review for the maintainer's separately authorized publication transition.

Independent recomputation confirms the 3:7 ratio, 30% and 41.666...% shares, 11.666... percentage-point increase, 38.888...% relative increase, and reverse check; the transfer answer and all other reviewed assessment arithmetic were retained.

Added check-clinical-reference-choice after the worked calculation. It asks the learner to explain the decisive denominator choice before reading process feedback that contrasts vial content with syringe capacity.
Changed the clinical scene's manifest coverage to claims-mapped and linked it to ratio, proportion, part-whole percentage, percent-change-reference, and percentage-point claims.

Added a learner-visible clinical-scene source note listing all five applied claim IDs and the complete retained NIST and Ministry of Justice source union after removal of the restricted OpenStax source.

The frozen candidate identity, version 0.2.0, objective alignment, scene order, duration, and file mappings were correct and remain unchanged except for the required clinical-scene claimCoverage repair.

evidenceChecked: Read all eight final scene sources in manifest order and confirmed exactly one level-one heading per scene, logical subordinate headings, semantic source order, and no position-dependent routing.

Confirmed every formative interaction is a labelled textual check with an untimed non-drag response route, attempt-before-feedback wording, and a complete static reading path that survives reflow and print.
Confirmed equations and quantitative relationships are also explained in words and no distinction depends only on color, sound, motion, hover, pointer gesture, animation, or timing.

Confirmed the pack contains no figures, diagrams, audio, video, datasets, third-party assets, remote embeds, raw HTML, HTML entities, JavaScript, active SVG, unsafe TeX commands, executable lesson code, or symlinks requiring an alternative modality, asset licence, or security exception.

Checked every final claim-to-scene-to-source relationship and every learner-visible source note; all retained source IDs resolve to records with locators, dates, versions, factual-reference uses, facts-only original-expression bases, rights evidence, and checked agent-access status.
Confirmed OpenStax is absent from the active source registry, claims, and learner-visible source notes; its removal and the reason for it are preserved in attribution and the frozen academic review.

Confirmed attribution identifies the accountable principal, authoring and clinical-revision runs, prior-version boundary, current finalizer run and digest, CC BY 4.0 lesson licence, fictional settings, original synthesis, and absence of reused media or source expression.

Confirmed the lesson contains no personal, learner, patient, credential, secret, real-drug, treatment, unsafe-experiment, or privacy-sensitive data; the clinical example is explicitly invented, educational, and not a prescription.
limitations: The scoped run did not render the lesson or exercise a physical keyboard, screen reader, 200% zoom, narrow viewport, reduced-motion setting, or non-web export; equivalent access was audited from canonical Markdown and JSON source only.

The operator prohibited reading site schemas and running npm, so formal JSON Schema, strict source-preflight, renderer, and repository validation remain required before merge; only JSON parsing, field constraints, mapping checks, Markdown/security scans, and source-level integrity checks were run here.

The finalizer relied on the committed access records and the academic review's live checks for retained sources rather than performing a new network terms check; no archived terms snapshots were available in the pack.

Equivalent non-dismissed GitHub COMMENTED transports were supplied by the operator and were not independently queried. Run IDs, providers, model families, and principal identities are disclosed attestations, not verified independence.
The rights audit applies the repository's conservative reuse policy and is not jurisdiction-specific legal advice.

rationale: The exact frozen candidate and both committed advisory reviews were read in full. The standard gate has two eligible request-changes inputs, zero approvals, the required academic and learning-design roles, two distinct declared runs and providers, and one accountable principal; no review was excluded, and no reviewer is represented as approving the final edit. Six findings were incorporated in one bounded revision and two positive note findings required no change. Manual JSON, identity, mapping, source-note, assessment-response, arithmetic, reference-field, semantic-source, privacy, security, accessibility, attribution, and rights checks passed. OpenStax no longer participates in the final evidence chain, every clinical teaching claim is mapped and visibly sourced, and no unresolved academic, learning, access, safety, or rights blocker remains in the source. Principal-level independence and automated validation are not claimed. On that evidence, the final content supports a merge decision subject to placeholder stamping and the required operator-run gates.
dissent: Both advisory reviews requested changes against the original candidate, and neither reviewer inspected or approved the finalizer's revision; this finalizer is accountable for the incorporated changes and final audit.

All authoring, review, and adjudication artifacts use the same accountable principal under the founding-stage allowance. The learning-design review declared that conflict, and no principal-level independence is claimed.

The academic review rejected the candidate's OpenStax agent-access record. The final revision resolves that objection by removing OpenStax from the active pack rather than representing it as verified or permitted.
conditions: Before merge, the accountable operator must replace PENDING-FINAL-COMMIT with the exact final content commit and replace all four RUNTIME-STAMPED identity fields from the runtime banner without changing teaching content.

Before merge, the operator must run the unchanged pack schemas, strict source preflight, renderer and repository validation, and exact GitHub-provenance checks required by project policy; any failure blocks merge until repaired within an authorized workflow.

After finalCommit is recorded, the maintainer may make only the separately authorized publication transition for lesson status, source confidence, and retained claim reviewStatus fields, then rerun the protected checks.
